english.note: Use 芬芳 mainly in written or literary descriptions of a pleasant fragrance.

exampleSentences.english: After the rain, the garden was filled with the perfume of roses.
exampleSentences.traditional: 雨後，花園瀰漫玫瑰芬芳。
